prompt: Refactor a central state machine whose behavior, schema, and tests all live in the same module and are still being redesigned.
context: Every proposed slice depends on one unresolved state-transition decision and overlaps the same core files.
expected_orchestration: Reject implementation fan-out and collapse the coupled dependency chain to one owner. Resolve and record the architecture decision before writing.
acceptance_checks: The unresolved decision is identified as the blocker.
The coordinator requests or records one approved contract.
Implementation starts only after a reliable oracle exists.
failure_signals: Files are divided mechanically among agents.
Agents negotiate a moving contract while editing.
Merge conflict resolution substitutes for architecture ownership.
